body:
MEASURED LIVE-RUNTIME RESOURCE HOLD; adapter work can proceed, but this host must not auto-download the model stack.

Required external artifacts:
- AMR3 parser checkpoint zip: 1,268,268,872 bytes, sha256 f503fd95...
- fairseq bart.large.tar.gz required when roberta_cache_path is closed explicitly: Content-Length 3,699,866,548 bytes; S3 version id rQ65JAqxcZ2XPx20RHLCFuXmbwZCDmWZ; ETag d2806533166d5328643cf4af02c72fb9-442.
Compressed total alone is 4,968,135,420 bytes. The host has 8.5 GiB free. Retaining downloads plus extracting both weight sets and creating Torch/fairseq dependencies would consume or exceed the safe margin.

I will not risk filling the shared volume. Live WOG coverage needs one of: owner-provided external storage/preinstalled pinned artifacts, a remote/container runner with adequate space, or a different fully pinned engine. Those are later execution decisions; none authorizes a silent fallback.

CONTRACT CONSEQUENCE: Unavailable(RuntimeDependencyUnpinned) is too narrow. All identities can be pinned while the runtime is honestly unavailable for ArtifactMissing, PlatformIncompatible, or ResourceBudgetInsufficient. The closed state and per-item typed failure must name the actual reason. Mapping measured disk insufficiency to Unpinned would be false provenance.

No download was started; this was HEAD/API metadata only.
